# Design
## When to use
Interface design or prototyping.
## Required context
User goal and constraints.
## Preconditions
Separate experiments from production.
## Procedure
Compare approaches and proof options. Obtain product decisions.
Activate `frontend-design` or `prototyping` only as needed.
## Tools
Project preview and checks.
## Rules
Keep accessibility and scope intact.
## Verification
Check the relevant interaction.
## Evidence
Observed behavior and experiment limits.
## Completion criteria
The design question has an answer.
## Failure modes
Unverified feasibility: label it.
## References
[Design options](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. `<plugin root>` is the installed Paved plugin directory, two directories above this SKILL.md. Always run the launcher from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
